name: Request to share a device-linking code or scan a linking QR
description: The recipient is asked to share a device-linking code or scan a linking QR under a benign-sounding pretext, which links the attacker's device to their messaging account.

source_references.quote: enables cybercriminals to take complete control of WhatsApp accounts without needing passwords or SIM swaps.
a device linking code on your WhatsApp or try to trick you into scanning a QR code under false pretenses

explanation.plain: Someone asked you to share a code or scan a QR to 'verify' or 'register' something. That code links your account to their phone and hands them control. Never share it.
explanation.technical: DEVICE_LINKING_CODE_REQUEST (device-action) with a benign/trusted pretext, spanning device and pretext/identity classes. Two independent verified sources (CERT-In, Meta).
verification_steps: Never share a code you received on WhatsApp/Signal with anyone.
Check Linked Devices in your app settings and remove unknown devices.

provenance.notes: Encoded in the WP3 rule-encoding pass; suppression via negative-indicator-library-v1.json.
